For reference, the A.S. section prints required courses MACH 021 (3), MACH 022 (4), MACH 070 (3), MACH 071 (3), MACH 075 (3), MACH 090 (3), MACH 129 (2), TECALC 087 (4), Total Units 25, plus SBVC GE or Cal-GETC. MACH 070, MACH 071, MACH 075 and TECALC 087 are not in the closed list.
The A.S. page prints five Program Learning Outcomes for the CNC Machining A.S. degree; they were not recorded because the text does not show that the certificate shares them.

The 25-unit A.S. major total and the closed list's 12 stored units do not fall clearly within the certificate's 16-30 unit award range, which also suggests the certificate's requirements differ from the A.S. list.
